title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Title Services: Purchase Option Fee, Quote Validity and Title Transfer
content:
# Title Services Schedule — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

When a business buys a unit leased under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, the figures below apply. They are identical in all six program tiers (Kestrel Business Advantage, Kestrel Fleet Select, Kestrel Fleet Preferred, Kestrel Fleet Premier, Kestrel Fleet Enterprise and Kestrel National Fleet).

| Item | Figure, every program tier |
|---|---|
| Purchase option fee added when the business buys a unit | 150 USD |
| Days a purchase quote is honoured | 10 calendar days |
| Title transferred after the purchase funds clear | within 10 business days |
| Administrative fee for transferring title on a purchased unit, where the title state allows | 75 USD |

## Notes

- The quote period is counted in calendar days; the title transfer period is counted in business days after the purchase funds clear. The two periods use different day counts.
- The title transfer fee is the administrative fee for transferring title where the title state allows it.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** A quote dated on a given day is honoured through the tenth calendar day after that date; title on a unit whose purchase funds cleared on a Monday is transferred within ten business days after that Monday.
